members.name: Mose Gebreselassie
members.bio: Mose brings more than ten years of commercial experience in international trade and logistics, quality control and sales. Having lived in more than eleven countries and speaking more than seven languages, he understands your market as well as the origin. He leads our buyer relationships, from the first brief to the repeat order.
highlights: 10+ years in trade, logistics, QC and sales

members.name: Natnael Samson
members.bio: Natnael has lived in Ethiopia for the past ten years and built an extensive network there, which is now at the heart of the company. He is our team on the ground: in close contact with exporters, following your samples and shipments, and making sure what is agreed is what happens.
